verdict.rationale: Bitwarden's integrated authenticator is documented only as producing standard TOTPs: six-digit SHA-1 codes that rotate every 30 seconds. Nothing in the pack covers Steam Guard codes, HOTP counter-based tokens, custom periods or custom digit lengths, so this applicable power-user axis has no supporting evidence.

support.subject: As a power user, non-standard tokens work too — Steam Guard, HOTP counters, custom periods and digit lengths
